requirements_summary: Workload: high-quality ticket summarization and structured extraction (subject, priority, tags, sla flag). Tool calling: create/update ticket in Zendesk via structured webhook; optionally call internal enrichment service. Latency target: <400ms median for short summaries for live chat; OK with up to 1s for batch nightly jobs. Throughput: peak ~20 req/s during business hours. Model preferences: small-to-medium open weights (13B-ish) for cost, with ability to fall back to cheaper q4 quantized variants. Must support stable JSON/CSV outputs and schema enforcement. Data: customer messages only (no sensitive PII in pilot), retention TBD. Platform fit: prefers hosted API with clear onboarding and examples; may consider Dedicated if volume grows.
